display: Round u16 RGB by (value+128)//257; retain exact original ICC; native tiles never resampled. Whole-image overview is orientation only.
selection: Locations fixed before any highlight candidate image exists. No source-prior candidate used to select locations. These natural scene regions are not calibrated flat-noise controls.

targets.name: bright-front-petal
targets.purpose: Broad bright petal, test retained yellow surface texture and transition without replacing it with a white or gray patch.

targets.name: bright-upper-petal
targets.purpose: Second bright petal at different position, test highlight colour and texture consistency.

targets.name: right-inner-bud
targets.purpose: Midtone yellow bud surface and grooves; protect colour and local detail away from a glaring highlight.

targets.name: dark-bud-gap
targets.purpose: Dark inter-bud transition; protect shadows and avoid lifted haze or crushed structure.

targets.name: fan-real-hairs
targets.purpose: Known real fine hairs through broad foreground defocus; a cleaner appearance must not erase those hairs.

targets.name: bright-rim-hairs
targets.purpose: Sharp hair tips over bright petal; test colour changes without loss or white enlargement of the tips.

targets.name: central-throat
targets.purpose: Low contrast throat with faint real-or-unresolved traces; protect against arbitrary darkening and calling lost faint lines a repair.
